author: n. i. myers
title: West Virginia baseball ends season with loss to North Carolina at College World Series
text:
The West Virginia University baseball team ended its season on June 17 with a 12-7 loss to North Carolina at the College World Series in Omaha, Nebraska. The Mountaineers concluded their best season in program history with a 47-17 overall record and were among the final four teams remaining nationally.
Head coach Steve Sabins said, “I couldn’t be more proud of this group of kids. What they were able to do and what they were able to accomplish is nothing short of miraculous. So thankful for these players, thankful for the seniors.”
Sabins continued, “We have kids in this group that have been part of the best season in program history twice. This is the best season in Mountaineer baseball history. They’ve been playing baseball for 135 years. So, this group of kids get to say that after 135 teams, that they were the first team to make it to Omaha, to play and be one of the last four teams standing. It’s certainly tremendous.”
Sophomore Gavin Kelly went 3-for-5 with a home run and two runs batted in, while senior Matthew Graveline went 4-for-4 with a walk and drove in two runs. Junior Armani Guzman added two hits and scored twice.
North Carolina took an early lead by scoring two runs in the first inning before West Virginia’s Graveline hit an RBI single to cut into the deficit after one frame. The Tar Heels expanded their advantage by scoring three runs each in both the third and fourth innings, followed by two more runs each in both the sixth and seventh innings for a commanding 12-1 lead.
West Virginia responded with five runs during a seventh-inning rally as seven consecutive batters reached base with contributions from Kelly’s triple as well as singles from Schoenfeld, Graveline, Ineich, and a passed ball bringing home additional runs. In the eighth inning, Kelly hit his nineteenth home run of the year—matching Jedd Gyorko and Mark Landers for most homers by a Mountaineer player in a single season.
